faqs.question: Do I need to bring my vehicle to your workshop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most repairs are carried out at our workshop so we have the right tools, materials, equipment and safety setup available.

faqs.question: How long will the repair take?
faqs.answer: Timeframes depend on the complexity of the job. Once we understand what needs repairing, we can give you a clearer estimate before work begins.

faqs.question: What makes and models do you work on?
faqs.answer: We work on all makes and models, including New Zealand-built, imported, custom-built and older vehicles.

faqs.question: Can you help with a small repair?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle small repairs, maintenance work, upgrades and major rebuilds. If you are unsure, send us a few details and we can let you know the next step.

faqs.question: Do you work on imported caravans and motorhomes?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work on imported, older and less common models that need specialist repair knowledge.

faqs.question: Can you repair water damage?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can assess leaks and water damage, repair affected areas, and help identify the cause to reduce the risk of further damage.
